title: Concept: OpenSSL version disclosed in a response
description: An OpenSSL version string in an error message in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The library version dates the TLS stack, which is the component an attacker checks first when looking for a handshake weakness.
applicability: Deployments that render an OpenSSL version string in an error message into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The library version dates the TLS stack, which is the component an attacker checks first when looking for a handshake weakness.
